title: Expand Work item details inline beneath the selected task header
outcome: On Greg's direct request, replace the Work panel side drawer with inline task expansion that uses available width in narrow and wide panels; preserve existing filters, views, data reads and detail content. Prepare on master for Greg's visual assessment before check-in.
acceptance: Selecting a task expands its details immediately beneath that task's header within the list, in both narrow and wide panels, without a separate side column.
Work views, filters, sorting, refresh, detail note pagination and keyboard closing remain functional; repeated label/tree occurrences render only the selected occurrence's details.
Greg can assess the changed layout on the main checkout before check-in; focused UI checks pass.
